title: user-update
description: An Admin changes an account's role, hourly write limit, status, or whether a Tier 2 may approve known fixes. At least one change.

writeLimit.description: Write commands allowed per hour before the user's writes pause.

stepUpToken.description: A one-time step-up token bound to this exact action.

canApproveFixes.description: Whether this person may approve the known fixes members submit. An Admin always may; for a Tier 2 it is granted here.
